data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'labab', which means 'to crave' or 'to desire'. In Islamic history, it was the name of a noble companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name symbolizes one's eagerness and enthusiasm towards pleasing Allah and following His teachings. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
